note: ground: lab draws the ground of this folder (cells as real domes from a baked life), standing draws the ground of convect.ts. sim: the life of the cells, a power diagram of sites on a tile that repeats (tile and radius in stage units, times in seconds). dome: the shape of a cell (arc: the angle of its profile from crown to foot in degrees, more than 90 hangs over the foot; height: of the cell's mean radius). lod: a dome is drawn with the finest mesh above the first size in pixels of a 1080 frame, the middle above the second. spot: the warp that combs the cells toward the spot (pull, wide in stage units) and the funnel of its pit.
